title: Qwen2.5-Math-PRM
paper_type_zh: 数学过程奖励模型发布与验证器披露账本
best_for_zh: 需要区分可用 PRM 推理接口、过程监督证据和未公开训练配方的读者
one_line: Qwen released 7B and 72B mathematical process reward models that score segmented reasoning steps through a 0–1 positive-class probability interface, but not their training data, labels, calibration, or construction/audit records.
Qwen 发布了 7B 和 72B 数学过程奖励模型：通过分段推理文本中 extra_0 分隔 token 的正类概率给出 0–1 步级奖励；但训练数据、标签、校准和构造/审计记录没有公开。
why: It separates a usable open PRM interface from the unreleased data and verifier evidence needed to reproduce, calibrate, or independently audit process supervision.
inclusion_reason: Official Qwen release of two mathematical process reward models with a concrete per-step inference/reward interface and a linked technical report, while the underlying data, labels, calibration, and reproducibility ledger remain materially undisclosed.

title: Problem
问题
html:
A released process reward model can offer a useful step-level scoring interface without revealing the examples, labels, or calibration that make its scores trustworthy. Qwen2.5-Math-PRM is a V2 migration overlay for a legacy model-release seed: its central evidence is Qwen's 2025 release of 7B and 72B mathematical PRMs, not a claim that the linked technical report's full research artifact is the same record.

This Card separates the deployable inference interface from unreported PRM construction. In particular, it does not turn a model card, Best-of-N evaluation context, or ProcessBench evaluation reference into evidence for released training traces, label semantics, or a reproducible verifier recipe.

已发布的过程奖励模型可以提供有用的步级评分接口，却不公开使其分数可信的样例、标签或校准。Qwen2.5-Math-PRM 是对 legacy 模型发布 seed 的 V2 migration overlay：其核心证据是 Qwen 在 2025 年发布 7B 与 72B 数学 PRM，而不是声称其链接的技术报告完整研究产物就是同一记录。

本 Card 将可部署的推理接口与未报告的 PRM 构造分开。尤其不会把模型卡、Best-of-N 评测语境或 ProcessBench 评测引用当作已发布训练轨迹、标签语义或可复现验证器配方的证据。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Qwen releases Qwen2.5-Math-PRM-7B and Qwen2.5-Math-PRM-72B as models for assessing mathematical reasoning quality and intermediate steps rather than generating an answer. The official release says they are fine-tuned from Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-Math-72B-Instruct, respectively.

The concrete disclosed contract is an inference interface. A reasoning response is segmented with double line breaks; an extra_0 separator token is inserted after each step; and the positive-class probability at each separator is extracted as a reward from 0 to 1. This establishes a per-step scoring interface. It does not establish what the positive label means, how steps were labeled, whether scores are calibrated, or how step scores should be aggregated for a training or selection decision.

Qwen 发布 Qwen2.5-Math-PRM-7B 和 Qwen2.5-Math-PRM-72B，用于评估数学推理质量和中间步骤，而非生成回答。官方发布称它们分别从 Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct 与 Qwen2.5-Math-72B-Instruct 微调而来。

具体披露的合同是推理接口：将推理回答用双换行分段，在每步后插入 extra_0 分隔 token，再提取每个分隔位置的正类概率，得到 0 到 1 的奖励。这确立了逐步评分接口，却未确立正类标签含义、步骤如何标注、分数是否校准，或应如何聚合步骤分数以作训练或选择决策。

title: Method
方法
html:
The official 7B model card's quick-start example supplies a system-level instruction, a mathematical query, and a reasoning response. It recommends double-newline step boundaries, inserts the extra_0 separator after each step, and reads the probability of the positive class at those positions. The card presents this as an inference procedure over reasoning text. Its precise training-record schema is not disclosed.

The announcement reports Best-of-N evaluation using eight samples from Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct and a response score formed as the product of individual step scores. It also introduces ProcessBench as an evaluation resource with 3,400 human-expert error-location-annotated test cases. Those statements are evaluation context, not a disclosure of the PRM training pool, label source, sampling protocol, filtering, optimizer, reward calibration, threshold, aggregation rule for all uses, or training rollout count.

官方 7B 模型卡的 quick-start 示例提供系统提示词、数学查询和推理回答。它建议用双换行作为步骤边界，在每一步后插入 extra_0 分隔 token，并读取这些位置的正类概率。模型卡将此呈现为对推理文本的推理过程；其精确训练记录 schema 未披露。

公告报告了 Best-of-N 评测：从 Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct 得到八个样本，并用每步分数的乘积形成回答分数。它还介绍了 ProcessBench 这个具有 3,400 个由人类专家标注错误位置的测试案例的评测资源。这些陈述属于评测语境，而不是对 PRM 训练池、标签来源、采样协议、过滤、优化器、奖励校准、阈值、所有用途的聚合规则或训练 rollout 数的披露。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The official Qwen release post establishes the 2025 release, the 7B and 72B artifacts, their Qwen2.5-Math-Instruct bases, the Best-of-N context, and the ProcessBench description. The official 7B model card and 72B model card establish the release artifacts, model-page license label, and the step-separator probability interface.

The official release pages cite The Lessons of Developing Process Reward Models in Mathematical Reasoning as a supporting technical report. In this migration Card, that report corroborates the release context; it does not replace the Qwen release title or supply unspecified training artifacts. No official training data, label set, standalone construction code, calibration package, or replay environment was verified in the checked sources.

官方 Qwen 发布文章确立了 2025 年发布、7B 与 72B 产物、其 Qwen2.5-Math-Instruct 基座、Best-of-N 语境和 ProcessBench 描述。官方 7B 模型卡和 72B 模型卡确立了发布产物、模型页许可证标签和步骤分隔位置的概率接口。

官方发布页将 The Lessons of Developing Process Reward Models in Mathematical Reasoning列为支持性的技术报告。在这个 migration Card 中，该报告佐证发布语境；它不替代 Qwen 发布标题，也不提供未指定的训练产物。所核查来源中没有验证到官方训练数据、标签集、独立构造代码、校准包或回放环境。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The useful disclosure is a compact but concrete interface contract: mathematical reasoning is segmented, a designated separator is scored, and a positive-class probability becomes a step reward. That makes the release more auditable than a generic claim that a PRM exists, while retaining the distinction between scoring use and training provenance.

For this track, its novelty is the boundary itself. It exposes a usable verification surface and model lineage but leaves the evidence necessary to audit process-supervision data, label validity, calibration, and reproducibility unresolved.

有价值的披露是一份紧凑而具体的接口合同：数学推理被分段，对指定分隔位置评分，并将正类概率变成步骤奖励。这使该发布比笼统地声称存在 PRM 更可审计，同时保留评分用途与训练溯源之间的区别。

对于本 track，其新意正是这条边界：它公开了可用的验证表面和模型谱系，却没有解决审计过程监督数据、标签有效性、校准和可复现性所需的证据。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The input format is part of the contract: the model card recommends double-newline segmentation and an extra_0 separator after each step, so formatting can change the reward sequence. The checked release does not define the positive label, step-quality taxonomy, label source, inter-annotator agreement, calibration, score aggregation beyond the reported Best-of-N example, thresholds, coverage, or error rates.

There is no verified release of PRM training prompts, traces, step records, labels, filters, retained or rejected examples, splits, decontamination evidence, generator or teacher, optimization settings, training code, or source-to-checkpoint lineage. The qwen model-page license label does not establish rights for unreported data. The linked report's warning that response-level Best-of-N can be biased for process verification should not be generalized into a claim of a calibrated PRM.

输入格式是合同的一部分：模型卡建议双换行分段，并在每步后使用 extra_0 分隔 token，因此格式选择会改变奖励序列。所核查发布没有定义正类标签、步骤质量分类、标签来源、标注者一致性、校准、除报告的 Best-of-N 示例外的分数聚合、阈值、覆盖率或误差率。

没有验证到 PRM 训练提示词、轨迹、步骤记录、标签、过滤、保留或拒绝样例、split、去污染证据、生成器或教师、优化设置、训练代码或来源到检查点谱系的发布。qwen 模型页许可证标签不建立未报告数据的权利。链接报告关于仅用回答级 Best-of-N 可能对过程验证产生偏差的警告，不应泛化为已校准 PRM 的主张。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use this Card when deciding whether an open PRM checkpoint is enough to support process-supervision or verifier claims. It provides a disciplined separation: the model interface can be tested on segmented reasoning text, but the data and labeling process behind the interface cannot yet be independently audited.

It is also useful for evaluating step-reward deployment. A user can document input formatting and per-step scores, but should not infer calibrated correctness probabilities, released ground-truth traces, or an RLVR training recipe from the model release alone.

在判断一个开放 PRM 检查点是否足以支持过程监督或验证器主张时，可使用本 Card。它提供了严格区分：模型接口可以在分段推理文本上测试，但接口背后的数据与标注过程目前不能独立审计。

它也适用于评估步骤奖励部署。用户可以记录输入格式和逐步分数，却不应仅凭模型发布推断出经校准的正确性概率、已发布真值轨迹或 RLVR 训练配方。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read the official Qwen release post first to distinguish the Qwen2.5-Math-PRM model release from the linked technical report.
  • Reproduce only the documented inference surface from the 7B model card: step segmentation, separator insertion, and positive-class probability extraction.
  • Treat Best-of-N and ProcessBench as evaluation context, not as released PRM training data, labels, or calibration evidence.

• 首先阅读官方 Qwen 发布文章，将 Qwen2.5-Math-PRM 模型发布与其链接的技术报告区分开。
  • 仅从 7B 模型卡复现已记录的推理表面：步骤分段、分隔 token 插入和正类概率提取。
  • 将 Best-of-N 和 ProcessBench视为评测语境，而不是已发布 PRM 训练数据、标签或校准的证据。
